name: Nacre
author: E. T. Carter
description: A soap bubble caught in the light — a thin transparent film over a single sphere, swirling with thin-film interference colours that shift toward the rim and churn slowly across the surface, finished with a sharp highlight. Mostly see-through, all iridescence.

params.label: Churn
params.effect: How fast the film thickness swirls across the bubble; 0 holds the pattern still.

params.label: Iridescence
params.effect: Strength of the thin-film colour; low is near-clear glass, high is saturated soap-film rainbow.

params.label: Bands
params.effect: Frequency of the interference bands; low is broad colour sweeps, high tight oily rings.

params.label: Bubble size
params.effect: How much of the frame the bubble fills; high crops in close, low pulls it back.

params.label: Mouse influence
params.effect: How strongly the pointer parallaxes the view; 0 ignores the mouse.
